job.title: Excavator and Front End Loader Operators
job.description:
About the Business
  • Growing business looking at multiple roles 
  • Looking at onboarding new teams with view to permanent opportunities
  • Competitive pay rates
  • Day/Afternoon and weekend roles available

Key Responsibilities: 
Utilising Either an Excavator or Front-end Loader you will be required to: 
  • Stock piling.
  • Digging holes and trenches.
  • Loading of trucks
  • Drainage work.

Essential Criteria:
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in a similar role
  • Australian driver's license is essential.
  • Ability to work Monday – Friday
